evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: Reporting a ratification enacts authority-ranking — a governance act of collective approval — performed through the document, with reported=true as an event-report.

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: Framing the contract's value as consequence-avoidance — lost work as the cost of a dropped receipt — enacts market-pricing proportionality.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Describing two equivalent reciprocal paths — poll or piggyback — frames the agent's retrieval as an even, turn-taking exchange rather than a hierarchical one.
